title: Lifted Up and Singing
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A song-writer once felt so stuck,
Down in a muddy pit,
He tried and tried but could not climb
His way up out of it.

[Chorus]
When you feel stuck or sad, call out,
To God, and He will hear,
He'll lift you up and give your heart
A new song, bright and clear.

[Verse 2]
'Heavenly Father, help!' he cried,
And God heard him that day,
He lifted him and set his feet
On rock that would not sway.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes, and if you're stuck,
Just call on Him tonight,
He'll lift you up, and in your heart
A thankful song sings bright.

[Chorus]
mood: Rising music. The pulse starts low and heavy, like feet stuck in mud, then lifts into a light, hopeful lilt as the chorus arrives, matching a story of being pulled up out of the pit. The sway keeps a gentle bounce of thankfulness under the second verse. By the last verse it settles down lower and slower, the bounce softening into a rocking hum.
